message.subject: Thought for the P5 series outdoor ecosystem
message.body:
Hi [Name],

Congrats on the P5 X and P5 SMP launches—the outdoor application focus is a smart play.

I've been thinking about how printer manufacturers can better support their customers' durability challenges downstream. We work with companies whose end-users were facing premature fading and UV damage on outdoor graphics, which was creating warranty headaches even though the equipment performed perfectly.

Would it make sense to explore how a protective film partnership could strengthen Durst's outdoor story and reduce those post-sale support issues?

Happy to share what we're seeing in the market.

Best,
[Your name]

personalization_used.hook: Recent P5 X and P5 SMP launches create opportunity to integrate Tedlar as recommended overlaminate for differentiated go-to-market story
personalization_used.value_prop_emphasized: UV protection and durability reducing warranty claims and support costs while supporting product ecosystem differentiation
